replacement.title: Consistent Page Footer
replacement.definition: The report must use a clean, consistent footer across all pages, including the final page.

patches.decision_note: Footer presence and consistency evolve independently from internal-header presentation and version-specific footer codes: the footer is requested across all pages, initially reported as working, and later found missing on page 4.

value_updates.header_style: clean and consistent across report pages

patches.decision_note: The source assigns the listed metadata collectively to the header and footer, so it does not support attributing every listed detail specifically to the header.
